definition: UCDP’s persistent event ID. Primary key in this file.
Competition case assigned by the documented UCDP dyad selection.
Focal is the designated UCDP dyad for the named case. Context identifies other selected dyads.
GED 26.1 for 2014–2025. Candidate 26.01.26.09 for January–September 2026.
UCDP event year.
Earliest possible event date (YYYY-MM-DD).
Latest possible event date (YYYY-MM-DD). A range may extend beyond the selection window.
Precision of the original dates. See the code list.
UCDP category of organised violence. See the code list.
UCDP conflict ID in the source release. Some Candidate IDs and names are provisional.
UCDP conflict name as published. Some Candidate names are temporary placeholders.
UCDP dyad ID in the source release. Links to documentation/event_scope.csv.
UCDP name of the actor pairing. A side can consist of multiple actors.
UCDP identifier for side A. A side can be a coalition.
UCDP name for side A. For one-sided violence this is the perpetrating side.
UCDP identifier for side B. A side can be a coalition.
UCDP name for side B. For one-sided violence this is civilians.
Derived economy join code for event location. Blank where international waters or airspace, or UCDP code 666 with no first-level area, prevent a reliable match.
Original UCDP Gleditsch–Ward location code. A location code is independent of the actors’ countries.
Original UCDP geographic label.
First-level administrative area supplied by UCDP, when available.
Broad UCDP region for the event location.
Precision of the original UCDP location. The competition file provides first-level geography. See the code list.
Whether the source reporting identifies a discrete incident or gives an inseparable aggregate. See the code list.
1 means UCDP coded an active conflict, dyad or actor year. 0 means it did not. Candidate classification is provisional.
UCDP coding review status. Clear indicates source coding status. Check labels identify a question under review.
Number of references consulted by UCDP for the event. Matches the number of rows in event_sources.csv for this event ID.
UCDP best estimate of fatalities sustained by side A. UCDP uses 0 for one-sided violence.
UCDP best estimate of fatalities sustained by side B. UCDP uses 0 for one-sided violence.
UCDP best estimate of civilian fatalities within this event.
UCDP best estimate of fatalities with unknown civilian or combatant status.
UCDP best estimate of total direct fatalities. Equals the sum of the four component fields.
UCDP low estimate of total direct fatalities. Preserved as published.
UCDP high estimate of total direct fatalities. Preserved as published.
Parent event ID in conflict_events.csv.
One-based order of the reference in the UCDP event record. Composite key with event_id.
Outlet, organisation or account recorded by UCDP. A few labels carry a Source: prefix for spreadsheet compatibility.
Publication date recorded by UCDP (YYYY-MM-DD). References may precede or follow an event.
Calendar year of the UNHCR end-year stock.
Origin code used by UNHCR. Composite key with year and asylum_iso3.
Asylum location code used by UNHCR.
Country or territory of origin label used by UNHCR.
Country or territory of asylum label used by UNHCR.
End-year refugees under UNHCR’s mandate, including persons in refugee-like situations as covered by UNHCR.
End-year asylum seekers in the UNHCR population series.
End-year persons in other international protection situations in UNHCR’s source. A dash in the source becomes a blank.
Published Refugee Data Portal record ID. Primary key in this file.
Reference month in the UNHCR source (YYYY-MM). This extract contains December values.
Calendar year derived from the reference month.
Country or territory of origin code in the source.
Country or territory where the population is recorded.
UNHCR stock category code. See the code list.
UNHCR stock category label.
Sex code from the source. See the code list.
Age band code from the source. See the code list.
Urban or rural residence code. See the code list.
Accommodation setting code. See the code list.
Reported people in the coded population and demographic cell. Reporting coverage varies.
IDMC conflict-related internal displacement or UNRWA refugee registration. See the code list.
Reference year of the stock or registration count.
Source economy or reporting area code. IDMC uses the area of internal displacement. UNRWA uses the area of registration. UNK is unknown.
Reporting area label from the relevant source.
People in the reference stock, as published. Interpret together with series_code.
World Bank economy code. Composite key with year.
Economy name in the World Bank source.
Calendar year, 2014–2025.
World Bank SP.POP.TOTL, midyear resident population estimate.
World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG, annual real GDP growth in percent.
World Bank FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG, annual consumer price inflation in percent.
